facts.raw_span: eruption on his trunk that began 2 months previously with multiple round red patches slowly increasing in size
neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) and juvenile xanthogranulomas
Treatment with griseofulvin and clotrimazole had not improved the rash
developed fever and was diagnosed with otitis media
Multiple annular, indurated, dusky red plaques with central clearing and trailing scale ranging from 1 to 6 cm in diameter on his trunk
Scattered café au lait macules present on the back
Perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate of cells with homogeneous chromatin and abundant cytoplasm
Immunohistochemical staining: Positive: CD33, CD123, CD4, CD163
White blood cell count: 76,400/µL
Annular dusky red indurated plaques on right flank and back with central clearing and trailing scale, scattered café au lait macules
Hematoxylin-eosin stain showing perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate (×40 and ×400 magnification)
No family history of NF1

rationales.F01: The eruption on the trunk is a non-specific finding that could be related to several conditions.
rationales.F02: The presence of neurofibromatosis type 1 and juvenile xanthogranulomas suggests a possible genetic predisposition to certain conditions.
rationales.F05: The description of the plaques is consistent with several conditions, including granuloma annulare and erythema annulare centrifugum.
rationales.F07: The perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate is a characteristic histopathological feature of Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
rationales.F08: The positive immunohistochemical staining for CD33, CD123, CD4, and CD163 supports the diagnosis of Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
rationales.F09: The elevated white blood cell count is a non-specific finding that could be related to several conditions, including leukemia cutis.
rationales.F11: The histopathological features seen on the hematoxylin-eosin stain are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
rationales.F12: The absence of a family history of NF1 makes it less likely that the condition is related to a genetic predisposition.
